question: A 7 metre high sculpture known as** 'Sadashiva’,** representing three aspects of Lord Shiva is found at ______ Caves.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Elephanta.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Elephanta Caves** are located in **Western India on Elephanta Island (otherwise known as the Island of Gharapuri)**, which features **two hillocks** separated by a narrow valley. The small island consists of numerous ancient archaeological remains that are the sole testimonies to its rich cultural past.
 
• These archaeological remains reveal the** existence** of life** since the 2nd century BC.**
 
• The** rock-cut Elephanta Caves** were constructed about the **mid-5th to 6th centuries AD**.
 
• The most important among the caves is the** great Cave 1 **as it has a length of about **39 meters from the front entrance** to the back.
